scope: Five actual production-UI browser storage flows in fresh isolated Chromium contexts; no user profile accessed
browser: Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.4 (Playwright chromium revision 1248, full Chromium headless channel)

checks.name: real IndexedDB/OPFS restore survives reload and backup preserves originals
correctly hashed malformed archive is rejected without replacing the open project
real browser write quota failure preserves the project and recovers its journal before retry
missing OPFS original blocks loading and reconnect restores the same project
renderer crash after a staged original commit recovers abandoned restore without touching the existing project

quota_method: CDP effective quota set to 1 byte; navigator estimate remains optimistic; verified visible write/cleanup failure, preserved original backup, empty recovered journal, no staged OPFS originals, then successful retry
earlier_harness_failures: Initial headless-shell run used a short navigation timeout
First full-Chromium baseline omitted welcome-dialog dismissal
Initial quota assertion expected admission refusal, but the actual effective-quota failure happened during writing/cleanup
Awaiting the Page.crash command cannot receive a renderer reply; corrected to await the page crash event
limitations: Synthetic SVG original and small projects only
Does not verify whole-browser termination, power loss, other interruption points, large archives, playback/export parity or 30-minute editing/AI stability
The default quota preflight remains unit-tested separately
crash_method: Pause only the isolated page after real OPFS close commits staged original bytes; crash actual renderer through CDP Page.crash; open a new page in the same context; verify abandoned journal and staged originals removed, existing backup bytes preserved, and restore retry succeeds
